Name: Multiple Farms For Multiplayer
Author: LyzzCL
Description:
[size=3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/PbTNDnG.png[/img]
Adds 7 additional farms (based on the vanilla layouts) around the valley. Perfect for multiplayer so everyone gets their own immersive space, but also works perfectly in single-player if you just want more land to build on. Everything is highly customizable via config!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qLNYGDt.png[/img][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]FTM[/url] - Required for the mod to work.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] - To easily configure your farms, starter items, and buildings in-game.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4715]Reset Terrain Features[/url] - Required only if you are updating the mod or adding it to an existing save.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Vi3uJBS.png[/img][/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3]Extract the folder inside the .zip into your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] to configure your desired settings [b]before[/b] creating a new world.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]Multiplayer & Config:[/b] Joining friends can now see where each cabin is located and rename them directly! Note that if you tweak the GMCM config later, you will need to reload your save for most changes to take effect.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/wOoWJWQ.png[/img][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][b]7 Vanilla Farms Included:[/b] Wilderness (monsters), Forest (forage), Beach (forage/crates), Riverland, Meadowlands (blue grass), Hilltop (quarry), and Four Corners (max space, no divider cliffs). Each keeps its original perks and fishes![/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]Customizable Options:[/b] Toggle starter crates, starter cabins, and starter buildings (e.g., Slime Hutch for Wilderness or a Coop for Meadowlands). Enable or disable specific farms, and customize their names for Robin's build menu.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]Advanced:[/b] Support for custom farms (requires basic knowledge of CP and Tiled).[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]Troubleshooting:[/b] If you notice you are getting errors due to something in my mod you can disable almost every aspect of my mod inside [b]Config > Other patches.[/b] Make sure to report it so I can fix it for future versions.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/efPYA1X.png[/img]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] — [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url] — [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url] — [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6626]Lunna Astray[/url] — [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12208]Fishing Pond Facilities[/url] — [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24852]Coal Point Farm[/url] — [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30295]Pelican Valley Loft[/url] — [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30888]Baldur's Village[/url] — [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44095]Gem Sea Shores[/url] — [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111]Sunberry Village[/url]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WqC0Bu1.png[/img][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21778]Build More Greenhouses[/url] - To allow greenhouses on the additional farms.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25081]Cabins to Farmhouses[/url] - Changes the look of cabins to feel like authentic farmhouses.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44746]Minecarted Multiplayer Farms[/url] - Adds fast-travel minecarts to every included farm![/size][/*]
[/list][size=3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/qTW7k5q.png[/img][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]You cannot move buildings or cabins between farms by default. Use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20606]Relocate Buildings And Farm Animals Mod[/url] for this.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Currently there are no caves on any map as they caused warp issues, addding them is planned for the future.[/size][/*]
[/list]

[center][size=3][url=https://ko-fi.com/lyzzcl][img width=250]https://storage.ko-fi.com/cdn/brandasset/v2/support_me_on_kofi_beige.png[/img][/url][/size][/center]
